name: Ana×Sis Feat. Kitani Sai
original_name: あな×シス Feat.木谷さい
source:
A voiced game that colors and animates two doujin manga:

1. 24-page doujin from Comic "Mejirizumu" by Kitani Sai
2. 24-page doujin from Comic "Mejirizumu" by Kitani Sai
translation:
一款为两部同人漫画着色并制作动画的有声游戏：

1. 北谷斋漫画《Mejirizumu》中的24页同人2. 北谷彩漫画《Mejirizumu》中的24页同人
